reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Payment of unclaimed moneys upon court order
headings.reviewNote: Covers court-ordered payment to the state treasurer within one year after final settlement of unpaid or unclaimed moneys held by an executor, administrator, assignee, sheriff, or receiver under section 470.010.

headings.title: Transferred property deemed unclaimed property under chapter 447
headings.reviewNote: Covers classification of transferred real and personal estate as unclaimed property governed by chapter 447 beginning January 1, 2003.

headings.title: Abolition of escheats fund and transfer of moneys and records
headings.reviewNote: Covers abolition of the escheats fund, transfer of moneys to the abandoned fund account, and transfer of accounting records to the unclaimed property division.

headings.title: Custody of fund commissioner bonds, interest, and proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Covers state treasurer custody of pre-2003 fund commissioner bonds, deposit of interest into the abandoned fund account, and use and disposition of proceeds in consultation with the board.

headings.title: Annual abandoned fund transfer to public schools fund
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory annual transfer from the abandoned fund account to the public schools fund equal to 5% of net transfers to general revenue beginning in FY 2003; source cross-references section 166.011.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on court-ordered unclaimed money payments, chapter 447 classification, escheats fund abolition, fund commissioner bonds, and annual 5% public schools fund transfer; notes cross-reference to section 166.011.

headings.title: Settlement credit and motion for judgment on unpaid moneys
headings.reviewNote: Covers settlement account credit and prosecuting attorney motion for judgment with eight percent interest against fiduciary and sureties upon ten days' notice.

headings.title: Summary determination, judgment entry, and assessment of costs
headings.reviewNote: Covers summary court determination, entry of judgment absent valid excuse, and assessment of proceedings costs against fiduciary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on settlement account credit, prosecuting attorney motion for judgment with 8% interest on ten days' notice, and summary determination with costs (Effective 6-19-02).
